title: Admin REST API sunset: migrate to GraphQL Admin API (2025-04)
summary: Shopify removed the remaining Admin REST API surface in API version 2025-04. REST resource clients such as rest.Product.all/find/count are removed from the SDKs; the GraphQL Admin API must be used instead.
body: As of 2025-04, REST Admin endpoints are no longer available and SDK resource helpers were deleted. Use the GraphQL client and product queries/mutations.
migration: Replace shopify.rest.Product.all(session) with a GraphQL Admin query: POST /admin/api/2025-04/graphql.json with { products(first: 50) { edges { node { id title } } } }. In the JS SDK use shopify.clients.Graphql; in Python use the GraphQL endpoint with shopify tokens rather than shopifyapi.Product.
